name: Hue Motion Sensor (EU)

radios.note: Hue's German (EAN 8719514342125) and US product pages list Bluetooth and Zigbee as communication protocols.

matter.note: The sensor has no CSA listing of its own as far as seen. Hue says products connected to a Hue Bridge work with Matter (Bluetooth-connected products do not), and the product pages list Matter among third-party systems. No Hue page seen names the sensor's Matter device type.

apple_home.note: Hue's EU and US pages list Apple Home among third-party systems; it works through the Bridge.

google_home.note: Hue's EU and US pages list Google Home among third-party systems; it works through the Bridge.

alexa.note: Hue's EU and US pages list Alexa among third-party systems; it works through the Bridge.

smartthings.note: Hue's EU and US pages list Samsung SmartThings among third-party systems; it works through the Bridge.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Hue integration covers motion sensors (with temperature and light level) through the Bridge. Pairing the sensor straight to a Zigbee coordinator is only described in forum posts, so it is not counted.

hubRequired.note: Hue says the sensor needs a Hue Bridge-controlled setup; the Bridge is sold separately. Up to 12 accessories with a Hue Bridge.

localControl.note: No page seen says whether the sensor works without internet.

senses.note: Temperature and light level are named in Home Assistant's Hue docs.

power.note: 2 × AAA included. Hue's US page quotes at least two years of battery life.

summary: Motion, temperature and light level are what the Hue Motion Sensor (indoor) reports, all over Zigbee to a Hue Bridge. The Bridge is what connects it to Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant. Two AAA batteries are included, and Hue quotes at least two years of life.
caveats: Needs a Hue Bridge, sold separately; Hue says Bluetooth-connected products don't work with Matter.
Hue lists a limit of 12 accessories with a Hue Bridge.
